scenarios.reasoning: The agent did solid technical work parsing the binlog using multiple approaches and tools, eventually using the StructuredLogger NuGet package to extract meaningful data. It correctly identified the Distrib property for DataSources and provided a reasonable explanation of the signing failure. However, the analysis of whether multiple projects share the same output directory was somewhat superficial - since only one project had evaluation data in the binlog, the agent couldn't fully answer whether other projects use the same Distrib path. The signing failure explanation was reasonable but partly speculative. The approach was methodical but took many steps to get there (24 tool calls).

rubricScores.criterion: Found the Distrib property value for the DataSources project
Checked whether other projects (Common, StorageLibrary) use the same Distrib path
Identified that multiple projects point to the same shared output folder (e.g. the ConfigurationLinterService path)
Explained how this shared folder causes the signing conflict — signtool encounters files owned by other projects

scenarios.scenario: Insight — Inspect Distrib property across projects in signing build
